tasks.subject: Task 0: Scaffold project and test runner
tasks.description:
**Goal:** An empty but runnable Next.js + TypeScript app with Vitest wired up and a passing smoke test.

**Files:**
- Create: `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `next.config.ts`, `vitest.config.ts`
- Create: `app/layout.tsx`, `app/page.tsx`
- Create: `lib/__tests__/smoke.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `npm run dev` serves a page on localhost:3000
- [ ] `npm test` runs Vitest and passes

**Verify:** `npm test && npx tsc --noEmit`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["package.json", "vitest.config.ts", "lib/__tests__/smoke.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test && npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["npm run dev serves localhost:3000", "npm test passes", "tsc --noEmit clean"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Database schema
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Postgres schema with an append-only ledger and a balance that is derived, not edited.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql`
- Create: `lib/supabase/server.ts`
- Create: `.env.example`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Migration applies cleanly to a fresh database
- [ ] Inserting two ledger rows with the same `external_id` fails
- [ ] `accounts.balance_cents` updates automatically when ledger rows are inserted
- [ ] Row-level security is on for every table

**Verify:** `npx supabase db reset`; duplicate-`external_id` insert fails with a unique violation.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql", "lib/supabase/server.ts", ".env.example"], "verifyCommand": "npx supabase db reset", "acceptanceCriteria": ["migration applies cleanly", "duplicate external_id rejected", "balance_cents maintained by trigger", "RLS enabled on all tables"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Pricing config and cost calculation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Cost of a job is computed by one pure, tested function reading one config file.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/billing/pricing.ts`, `lib/billing/cost.ts`
- Test: `lib/billing/__tests__/cost.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A 0-second job bills 0; a 1-second job bills 1 minute
- [ ] 61 seconds bills 2 minutes (round up)
- [ ] PAYG rate is read from config, not hardcoded in the calculation
- [ ] Subscription minutes are consumed before credit is charged

**Verify:** `npx vitest run lib/billing`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/billing/pricing.ts", "lib/billing/cost.ts", "lib/billing/__tests__/cost.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run lib/billing", "acceptanceCriteria": ["0s bills 0, 1s bills 1 minute", "61s bills 2 minutes", "rate from config", "plan minutes consumed before credit"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Speaker turns and export formatters
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Provider segments become readable speaker turns, and turns become `.txt`, `.srt`, and `.docx` — all pure functions with tests.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/transcript/types.ts`, `lib/transcript/turns.ts`
- Create: `lib/export/txt.ts`, `lib/export/srt.ts`, `lib/export/docx.ts`
- Test: `lib/transcript/__tests__/turns.test.ts`, `lib/export/__tests__/{srt,txt,docx}.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Consecutive segments from the same speaker merge into one turn
- [ ] A speaker change always starts a new turn
- [ ] SRT timestamps are `HH:MM:SS,mmm` and zero-padded
- [ ] SRT cue numbering starts at 1 and increments
- [ ] `.txt` with a single speaker has no speaker labels at all
- [ ] `.docx` produces a non-empty buffer that unzips as a valid OOXML package

**Verify:** `npx vitest run lib/transcript lib/export`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/transcript/types.ts", "lib/transcript/turns.ts", "lib/export/txt.ts", "lib/export/srt.ts", "lib/export/docx.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run lib/transcript lib/export", "acceptanceCriteria": ["same-speaker segments merge", "speaker change starts new turn", "SRT timestamps HH:MM:SS,mmm zero-padded", "SRT cues numbered from 1", "single speaker means no labels", "docx is valid OOXML zip"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Provider interface + AssemblyAI adapter
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One narrow interface for transcription, one implementation behind it, with the response-mapping logic tested against a saved fixture.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/transcription/types.ts`, `lib/transcription/assemblyai.ts`, `lib/transcription/index.ts`
- Create: `lib/transcription/__fixtures__/completed.json`
- Test: `lib/transcription/__tests__/assemblyai.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `TranscriptionProvider` exposes exactly `submit`, `fetchResult`, `verifyWebhook`
- [ ] AssemblyAI utterances map to our `Segment[]` with correct ms timings and speaker labels
- [ ] `submit` sends `audio_end_at` when a cap is given, and omits it otherwise
- [ ] `verifyWebhook` rejects a wrong secret and accepts the right one
- [ ] Nothing outside `lib/transcription/` imports the AssemblyAI SDK or its URL

**Verify:** `npx vitest run lib/transcription` (tests stub global fetch — no API key needed)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/transcription/types.ts", "lib/transcription/assemblyai.ts", "lib/transcription/index.ts", "lib/transcription/__fixtures__/completed.json"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run lib/transcription", "acceptanceCriteria": ["interface has submit/fetchResult/verifyWebhook only", "utterances map to Segment[] with ms timings", "audio_end_at sent only when capped", "webhook secret verified in constant time", "provider SDK confined to lib/transcription"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Anonymous trial quota
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One free transcript per anonymous visitor that survives a page refresh, plus a global daily spend ceiling.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/quota/identity.ts`, `lib/quota/anon.ts`, `lib/quota/redis.ts`
- Create: `lib/turnstile.ts`
- Test: `lib/quota/__tests__/identity.test.ts`, `lib/quota/__tests__/anon.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The same ip + fingerprint pair always yields the same key; a change in either yields a different one
- [ ] Raw IPs are never stored — only the hash
- [ ] A second claim by the same identity is refused
- [ ] Once the daily budget is spent, all anonymous claims are refused regardless of identity
- [ ] Turnstile verification failure refuses the claim WITHOUT consuming it

**Verify:** `npx vitest run lib/quota` (fake QuotaStore — no Redis needed)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/quota/identity.ts", "lib/quota/anon.ts", "lib/quota/redis.ts", "lib/turnstile.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run lib/quota", "acceptanceCriteria": ["anonKey stable per visitor, changes with either input", "raw IP never stored", "second claim refused", "daily budget ceiling refuses everyone", "failed bot check does not consume the claim"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Upload and job-creation API
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A browser can get a signed upload URL, put a file straight into Storage, and start a transcription — without the file ever touching a serverless function.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/api/jobs/init/route.ts`, `app/api/jobs/[id]/start/route.ts`, `app/api/jobs/[id]/route.ts`
- Create: `lib/jobs/media.ts`, `supabase/migrations/0002_storage.sql`
- Test: `lib/jobs/__tests__/media.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `POST /api/jobs/init` returns `{ jobId, uploadUrl, uploadToken, maxDurationSeconds }`
- [ ] It refuses unsupported MIME types before creating anything
- [ ] Anonymous callers without a valid Turnstile token get 403
- [ ] Signed-in callers with insufficient credit get 402 before any provider call
- [ ] `POST /api/jobs/[id]/start` submits to the provider and stores `provider_job_id`
- [ ] Anonymous jobs are submitted with `maxDurationMs = 600000`

**Verify:** `npx vitest run lib/jobs`; then the curl flow — first call returns a jobId, second returns `already_used` with 403.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/api/jobs/init/route.ts", "app/api/jobs/[id]/start/route.ts", "app/api/jobs/[id]/route.ts", "lib/jobs/media.ts", "supabase/migrations/0002_storage.sql"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run lib/jobs", "acceptanceCriteria": ["init returns jobId and signed upload URL", "unsupported MIME rejected with 415", "anon without Turnstile gets 403", "insufficient credit gets 402", "start stores provider_job_id", "anon jobs capped at 600000ms"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: Webhook handler
tasks.description:
**Goal:** When the provider calls back, the transcript is stored and the account is debited exactly once, even if the callback arrives five times.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/api/webhooks/assemblyai/route.ts`
- Create: `lib/jobs/complete.ts`, `supabase/migrations/0003_minutes.sql`
- Test: `lib/jobs/__tests__/complete.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A forged webhook (wrong secret) gets 401 and changes nothing
- [ ] The handler responds 200 within its budget, doing the slow work after responding (`after()`)
- [ ] A duplicate delivery does not insert a second ledger row
- [ ] A failed transcription sets `status = 'failed'` and debits nothing
- [ ] Plan minutes are consumed before credit

**Verify:** `npx vitest run lib/jobs`; forged-webhook curl returns 401.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/api/webhooks/assemblyai/route.ts", "lib/jobs/complete.ts", "supabase/migrations/0003_minutes.sql"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run lib/jobs", "acceptanceCriteria": ["forged webhook gets 401", "responds 200 fast, work in after()", "duplicate delivery inserts no second ledger row", "failed transcription debits nothing", "plan minutes consumed before credit"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: Reconciliation cron
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A job whose webhook never arrived finishes anyway, instead of spinning forever.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/api/cron/reconcile/route.ts`
- Create: `vercel.json`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Requests without the cron secret get 401
- [ ] Jobs in `processing` for over 30 minutes are re-checked against the provider
- [ ] A job the provider reports as complete gets the same treatment as a webhook delivery
- [ ] Jobs stuck over 6 hours are marked `failed`

**Verify:** `curl localhost:3000/api/cron/reconcile` → 401; with the bearer secret → 200.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/api/cron/reconcile/route.ts", "vercel.json"], "verifyCommand": "curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' localhost:3000/api/cron/reconcile", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no secret returns 401", "jobs processing over 30min re-checked", "completed jobs applied like a webhook", "jobs stuck over 6h marked failed"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```
